figures.message: Bar charts or grouped plots visualizing grouped Sobol S1 and ST for LAP/CP and VI1/VI2 (derived from sobol_grp CSV files).
figures.caption_draft: Bar charts or grouped plots visualizing grouped Sobol S1 and ST for LAP/CP and VI1/VI2 (derived from sobol_grp CSV files).
figures.generation_prompt: Create a grouped vertical bar chart (aspect ratio 16:9) that shows grouped first-order (S1) and total-effect (ST) Sobol indices for two groups: LAP/CP and VI1/VI2. X-axis: four grouped categories in this order: LAP, CP, VI1, VI2 (each group label centered under its two bars). For each category draw two adjacent bars: S1 (left) and ST (right). Y-axis: Sobol index (unit: fraction 0–1); set tick marks at regular intervals but do NOT invent values — plot the exact numeric S1 and ST values from the author's sobol_grp CSV files. Order the groups left-to-right as listed above. Use a high-contrast, colorblind-safe palette: S1 = dark blue, ST = orange; include a legend in the top-right labeling the colors and "S1" and "ST". Place value annotations above each bar showing the exact numeric value from the data (if a value is missing, display the clear placeholder text "VALUE_MISSING"). Add a single annotation callout highlighting the largest ST across the four groups (pointing to the bar) with the text "largest ST". Style: clean academic vector style, white background, sans-serif font, thin gridlines only on the y-axis, no 3D effects or decorative elements. Use ONLY the author's real values from sobol_grp CSV; do not invent numbers.

figures.message: Table of individual-parameter Sobol indices (S1, ST) showing ranking of parameters (derived from sobol_ind CSV files).
figures.caption_draft: Table of individual-parameter Sobol indices (S1, ST) showing ranking of parameters (derived from sobol_ind CSV files).
figures.generation_prompt: Render a formatted two-column ranking table (portrait orientation) of individual-parameter Sobol indices derived from the author's sobol_ind CSV files. Table columns: (1) Rank (1 = highest ST), (2) Parameter name, (3) S1, (4) ST, (5) Delta (ST - S1). Sort rows by ST in descending order. Use the exact numeric S1 and ST values from the CSV to compute and display Delta; do NOT invent any numbers — if any value is unavailable, show the placeholder text "VALUE_MISSING" in that cell. Table header row should be bold, left-align Parameter name, right-align numeric columns with 3 decimal places if available. Use subtle horizontal separators between rows, no vertical lines, white background, legible sans-serif, and a small caption below the table: "Parameters ranked by total Sobol index (ST)." Use ONLY the author's real values; leave clear placeholders where data are missing.
